description: Report a problem with Bento itself to the Bento team. Call this without asking when a Bento command, endpoint or tool failed, behaved differently from its docs, or made you work around a missing capability, and when the user asks you to pass something on to the Bento team. Do not report bugs in the user’s own code, failures of third-party services, or your own mistakes. Report each distinct problem once per session. Write markdown: what you were trying to do, the exact command or tool and the error it returned, what you expected, and any workaround you used. Write it so someone without your conversation can reproduce it. Leave out secrets, tokens and personal data that the report does not need. After sending, tell the user in one line that you reported it.
name: feedback_create
